subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

48 CAN ∶ 12 EET ∶∶ 52 MUG ∶ 7 OYM ∶∶ 35 BOX ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

According to english alphabet positional value,

The pattern followed here is : 

48 CAN ∶ 12 EET

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fcf47aee7b15881408b9d16704266f0912c080ac743f13c4b5793cc96ae20311.png] 

And,

52 MUG ∶ 7 OYM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81fa5cc5c8c663d4a9340e826772a0c03c20d1e55858e908be48c2763ce72e57.png] 

Similarly,

35 BOX ∶ **8 DSD**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cad954ef68233ee3c4745ee25dfd92900e1e2f31057c48da431158ec97139bd1.png] 

Hence, **"Option 3"** is the **correct answer.**
